task.title: Deleting a repository by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To delete an image repository in Quay, you can use the UI. You remove the repository and its tags from the selected namespace.

step.cmd: On the Repositories page of the v2 UI, check the box of the repository that you want to delete, for example, quayadmin/busybox.
Type confirm in the box, and then click Delete.

info.p: After deletion, you are returned to the Repositories page.
